title: fog: Generating Expressive Motion through Layered Function Composition of Code for Heider-Simmel Animation
abstract: arXiv:2607.07952v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Motion and emotion are core parts of intelligent, expressive behavior. In this paper, we introduce fog, a layered function composition framework for generating motion functions. We demonstrate how fog can be used to express motion and emotion in Heider-Simmel style animations. This code generation framework can help users generate functions for verbs, adverbs, and emotions to capture the trajectory, manner, and feeling of motion. It is complemented by an animation editor that helps users provide spatial context in the form of marks, arrows, and paths. We evaluate our approach with a technical evaluations investigating different function generation and composition setups. In a mixed-methods user study (n=12), we find that fog can support users can support users by relaying spatial context they mark and draw and giving them more dimensions for control.

translated_title: fog：通过代码的分层函数组合为海德-西美尔动画生成富有表现力的运动
translated_abstract: 运动和情感是智能、富有表现力行为的核心组成部分。在本文中，我们介绍了fog，一个用于生成运动函数的分层函数组合框架。我们展示了如何使用fog在海德-西美尔风格的动画中表达运动和情感。这一代码生成框架可以帮助用户生成对应动词、副词和情感的函数，以捕捉运动的轨迹、方式和感觉。此外，该框架还配备了一个动画编辑器，帮助用户以标记、箭头和路径的形式提供空间上下文。我们通过技术评估研究了不同的函数生成与组合设置，以评估我们的方法。在一项混合方法用户研究（n=12）中，我们发现fog能够通过传递用户标记和绘制的空间上下文，并为用户提供更多维度的控制，从而有效地支持用户创作。
tldr: 提出fog分层函数组合框架，通过生成动词、副词和情感对应的代码函数来捕捉运动的轨迹、方式和感觉，帮助用户在海德-西美尔风格动画中表达运动与情感。
en_tdlr: fog is a layered function composition framework that generates code functions for verbs, adverbs, and emotions to capture the trajectory, manner, and feeling of motion, enabling users to create expressive Heider-Simmel style animations.
